name: REAP
source:
REAP is a suspenseful interactive fiction set in 1991 China, when the whole nation is spiraling upward while you—a man who doesn't even remember his own name—fall from a cliff into an unknown village.

The villagers are kind, but there are still things you find not normal. Will you be able to find your redemption, or do you not need redemption at all?

The game is currently just a prototype. Please note that you may encounter awkward English phrasing, incomplete scenes, and bugs.
translation:
《REAP》是一部悬疑互动小说，背景设定在1991年的中国，整个国家正在螺旋式上升，而你——一个连自己名字都不记得的人——从悬崖上掉进了一个不知名的村庄。

村民们都很友善，但还是有一些不正常的地方。你能找到救赎，还是根本不需要救赎？

该游戏目前还只是一个原型。请注意，你可能会遇到尴尬的英语措辞、不完整的场景和错误。
